evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically to all identifiable members, plus $6 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
we can reduce our fee request to $5 million if Brightline increases the class fund to $30 million.

summary: Plaintiff-side counsel first raised attorneys’ fees in the public settlement term sheets, before class relief was finally settled. Fees and class relief were negotiated together, and Hargrove expressly linked reducing its fee request to increasing the class fund. The transcript does not clearly show plaintiff counsel prioritizing firm interests over the class, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
